description: Canonicalization edge cases — prefix matrix completion (כ, ש), multi-token nikud, mixed Hebrew/Latin, geresh, collision (Wave 2).
notes: All cases use lemma_phrase=null to test the surface-text path through canonicalize_hebrew_term(). No implementation changes — all gaps were coverage gaps in gold/tests, not code defects. Pipeline summary: strip_nikud → normalize_quotes → split → filter standalone prefix tokens → strip_prefixes (3-char guard) → join '_' → lowercase → remove non-[Hebrew/digit/Latin/_/space] chars.

canonicalize_cases.description: Prefix כ strips when ≥3 chars remain — 'כחוק' → 'חוק'
canonicalize_cases.notes: כ (as/per) + חוק (law). strip_prefixes: 'כ' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('כחוק')-1=3 ≥ 3 → strips → 'חוק'. 'ח' not in prefixes. Correct by design: כ as the 'like/as' prefix stripped correctly.

canonicalize_cases.description: Prefix כ NOT stripped — 3-char guard saves 'כלי' (tool)
canonicalize_cases.notes: strip_prefixes: 'כ' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('כלי')-1=2 < 3 → guard prevents stripping. Same 3-char rule as C06_09 ('בו'), now verified for prefix כ. Correct by design.

canonicalize_cases.description: Prefix ש NOT stripped — 3-char guard saves 'שכר' (salary)
canonicalize_cases.notes: strip_prefixes: 'ש' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('שכר')-1=2 < 3 → guard prevents stripping. Same 3-char rule verified for prefix ש. Correct by design.

canonicalize_cases.description: Prefix ש strips when ≥3 chars remain — 'שמחה' → 'מחה' (KNOWN LIMITATION)
canonicalize_cases.notes: KNOWN LIMITATION: same class as C06_06 (מדינה→דינה). strip_prefixes: 'ש' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('שמחה')-1=3 ≥ 3 → strips → 'מחה'. Then 'מ' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('מחה')-1=2 < 3 → guard prevents. 'שמחה' (happiness) loses its 'ש' root letter. Prefix stripping is purely character-based — no semantic awareness. This is intentional behavior given the algorithm's design.

canonicalize_cases.description: Multi-token phrase where BOTH tokens carry nikud — all nikud stripped
canonicalize_cases.notes: strip_nikud() operates on full text before tokenizing → both 'בֵּית' and 'סֵפֶר' become 'בית' and 'ספר'. Then strip_prefixes: 'ב' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('בית')-1=2 < 3 → guard. canonical: 'בית_ספר'. Correct by design: multi-token nikud handled identically to single-token (C06_06).

canonicalize_cases.description: Mixed Hebrew/Latin phrase — Latin letters preserved and lowercased
canonicalize_cases.notes: Tokens: ['קוד', 'Python']. strip_prefixes: 'ק' and 'P' not in HEBREW_PREFIXES → unchanged. Join: 'קוד_Python'. lowercase: 'קוד_python'. Cleanup regex keeps Latin letters (a-zA-Z). By design: Latin preserved, lowercased. Pipeline step order: join → lowercase → cleanup.

canonicalize_cases.description: Geresh (׳, U+05F3) stripped — same cleanup path as gershayim (C06_07)
canonicalize_cases.notes: normalize_quotes(): GERESH U+05F3 → ASCII apostrophe ' (U+0027). Token: 'צה'ל'. strip_prefixes: 'צ' not in HEBREW_PREFIXES → unchanged. Join: 'צה'ל'. lowercase: 'צה'ל'. Cleanup: ' (U+0027) is NOT in allowed chars [Hebrew/digit/Latin/_/space] → stripped → 'צהל'. By design: same mechanism as gershayim ״ (C06_07).

canonicalize_cases.description: Collision case A — 'מות' (death): מ NOT stripped (3-char guard)
canonicalize_cases.notes: strip_prefixes: 'מ' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('מות')-1=2 < 3 → guard prevents stripping → 'מות'. Correct by design. Paired with C06v2_09: 'כמות' (quantity) also produces 'מות' — documented collision.

canonicalize_cases.description: Collision case B — 'כמות' (quantity) → 'מות': collides with C06v2_08 (KNOWN LIMITATION)
canonicalize_cases.notes: KNOWN LIMITATION: collision. strip_prefixes: 'כ' in HEBREW_PREFIXES, len('כמות')-1=3 ≥ 3 → strips → 'מות'. Then 'מ' guarded (len-1=2). 'כמות' (quantity) and 'מות' (death) are completely unrelated words — they share the same canonical key. Any cluster containing both would incorrectly merge them. This is an extension of the מדינה→דינה limitation to the collision domain. No fix available without semantic/morphological analysis.
